notes: ARINC 429 (Mark 33 DITS) is a wire-level avionics protocol spec; no OTP / fuse / configuration ROM at the protocol layer. Concrete ARINC 429 transceiver / controller devices (Holt HI-3584 / HI-8783, Texas Instruments DEI1016, Microchip / DDC) may use device-level OTP or non-volatile config to lock label-filter content, channel speed, or parity-enable defaults, but this is a per-device feature, not protocol-defined. The label → meaning assignments per equipment type (e.g. label 203 = barometric altitude for any Air Data Computer) are defined in ARINC 429 Part 1-17 Sections 78-116 as a paper specification, not as on-chip OTP.
